notes.title: Update - June 2018
notes.content:
Hello, patient players!

It seems that the game appeared in the "new releases" section again, so we must say sorry again because of this new inconvenience.
Even if we have our release date set as "soon", sometimes, steam decides a date by itself and that's why the game has appeared in the releases a pair of times. I've set the date for 40 years from now, so I hope it won't happen again! (And I also hope that the game is out this year and not in 40!) XD

As a small update, we've found some help to try and work a little faster, so we're excited about our new working pace. We can't still give any dates because we want to be really careful with that matter, so... I don't have any exact news on that.
What I can say is that the game has really improved in quality from our last build so, in that particular case, the wait will be beneficial.

I will try to add some new content if that doesn't mean spend some extra time until release so, please, be patient. I'm also a gamer and I'm always anxious about releases, but I ask you to understand all the difficulties we've encountered since we had to start from scratch. At least, if we ever manage to create another game, this won't happen again.

That's all for now, our patient players! I will try to find some other ways to compensate your patience!

Talk to you soon... and with better news, I hope!
